title: Um fim de semana na costa
grammar: Was e were para descrever como foi um lugar ou um dia
goal: Use was e were para descrever como estava um lugar, um dia ou uma pessoa.
reading: The beach was crowded on Sunday afternoon.
A praia estava lotada no domingo à tarde.
The ocean was cold, but one swimmer was happy.
O oceano estava frio, mas um nadador estava feliz.
Nico and Peg were tired after the drive to the tropical coast.
Nico e Peg estavam cansados depois da viagem de carro até a costa tropical.
From their hotel room, the horizon was beautiful.
Do quarto do hotel deles, o horizonte era lindo.
Their room was small, but the beds were comfortable.
O quarto era pequeno, mas as camas eram confortáveis.
dialogue: How was your weekend at the coast?
Como foi seu fim de semana na costa?
It was great, but the beach was crowded.
Foi ótimo, mas a praia estava lotada.
Os quartos do hotel eram caros?
No, they were cheap, and the horizon was amazing!
Não, eram baratos, e o horizonte era incrível!
Os frutos do mar estavam bons?
It was excellent, and the reef was beautiful too.
Estava excelente, e o recife também era lindo.
Were you there on Monday too?
Vocês ainda estavam lá na segunda?
No, we were home by Sunday night.
Não, já estávamos em casa no domingo à noite.
pron: Na frase, was soa fraco /wəz/ e were soa /wər/. Só carregue na palavra seguinte.
